hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap implements a custom AMM using a configurable bonding curve backed by Euler Protocol vaults. On each swap, the hook deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, enforcing a custom curve invariant. Liquidity providers supply assets through Euler accounts rather than standard Uniswap v4 positions; the hook blocks direct liquidity addition and donation.
